tutorialDialog.title: Password Recovery Tickets Tutorial
tutorialDialog.desc: Five quick steps to master the ticket flow from intake to resolution.

tutorialSteps.title: Tickets arrive automatically
tutorialSteps.body: When a customer requests a password reset via the chat widget, the AI collects their username, bank, and phone, then a ticket appears automatically in the Checking tab. You'll get notified if you've enabled it.

tutorialSteps.title: Review data and change status if needed
tutorialSteps.body: Click a ticket to see customer details and Google Sheet data. Use the 'Override status' dropdown to move tickets to Checking, Rejected, or Solved per your decision.

tutorialSteps.title: Send the new password in one tap
tutorialSteps.body: Once a ticket is Solved and a new password is available, click 'Send Password to Customer' to send a message with the new password directly to the customer's chat — no manual writing needed.

tutorialSteps.title: Open the row in Google Sheet
tutorialSteps.body: The 'Open Sheet' button takes you to the matching row in the Google Sheet for audit, correction, or manual changes. Sheet edits sync back every few seconds.

tutorialSteps.title: Enable desktop notifications
tutorialSteps.body: Enable desktop notifications from the banner above so you keep getting alerts about new tickets and status changes even when the Chatvice tab is inactive.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.liveMessage: Your chatbot is live and ready to serve customers.

agent.title: Create your first AI Agent
agent.description: An agent is your chatbot's brain. Without an agent, the widget cannot answer messages.
agent.autoDetectHint: Marked complete automatically once at least one agent is created.

tutorial.title: Open the AI Agents page
tutorial.body: In the dashboard sidebar, click the AI Agents menu to open the agent management page.

tutorial.title: Click Create New Agent
tutorial.body: Press the Create New Agent button in the top right of the page.

tutorial.title: Fill in agent data
tutorial.body: Enter the agent name (e.g. Store Assistant), pick the AI model (GPT-4.1-mini recommended), and write the agent's personality/role so its replies match your brand.

tutorial.title: Activate the agent
tutorial.body: Click Save, then set this agent as the Active Agent for the widget. This is the agent that will greet your visitors.

widget-settings.title: Configure widget appearance
widget-settings.description: Tweak colors, position, icon, greeting, and suggested questions so the widget matches your brand.
widget-settings.autoDetectHint: Mark complete after you save the basic widget settings.

tutorial.title: Open the Widget page
tutorial.body: From the sidebar, click the Widget menu to access appearance settings.

tutorial.title: Pick color and position
tutorial.body: Set the widget primary color (preferably matching your brand), pick bubble position (left or right), and light/dark theme.

tutorial.title: Upload icon and agent photo
tutorial.body: Upload a custom widget icon (optional) and an agent profile photo to make it feel more personal.

tutorial.title: Set greeting and suggested questions
tutorial.body: Write the welcome message that appears when the widget opens. Add suggested questions so visitors know what they can ask.

tutorial.title: Pick interaction mode
tutorial.body: Choose click-to-open (widget opens when clicked) or auto-open (widget opens automatically with an AI greeting).

tutorial.title: Mark complete
tutorial.body: After all basic settings are saved, click Mark complete on the Getting Started checklist.

prechat.title: Configure Prechat
prechat.description: Set welcome bubble, name collection, banner, and AI greeting for an engaging first impression.
prechat.deepLinkLabel: Open the Prechat tab in Widget
prechat.autoDetectHint: Mark complete after the prechat settings are saved.

tutorial.title: Open the Prechat tab
tutorial.body: On the Widget page, pick the Prechat tab to open the initial form settings.

tutorial.title: Enable welcome bubble
tutorial.body: Write a short message that appears next to the widget icon to attract visitor attention.

tutorial.title: Configure name collection
tutorial.body: Enable name collection if you want to ask for the visitor's name (and optionally phone number) before chat starts.

tutorial.title: Upload prechat banner
tutorial.body: Upload a banner image (optional) to display promotions, business hours, or branding above the prechat form.

tutorial.title: Enable AI greeting
tutorial.body: If you want the AI to greet visitors first with a personal message, enable AI greeting in settings.

tutorial.title: Mark complete
tutorial.body: Once everything is saved, click Mark complete on the checklist.

domain.title: Register your website domain
domain.description: Add your website domain to the whitelist so the widget only runs in legitimate places.
domain.deepLinkLabel: Open the Embed/Domain tab in Widget
domain.autoDetectHint: Marked complete automatically once at least one domain is validated.

tutorial.title: Open the Embed/Domain tab
tutorial.body: On the Widget page, pick the Embed (Allowed Domains) tab to manage allowed domains.

tutorial.title: Add a domain
tutorial.body: Click Add Domain and enter your website domain (example: example.com, no http:// and no www).

tutorial.title: Validate the domain
tutorial.body: Click Validate. The system will check that the widget is installed on that domain. If successful, the Validated badge appears.

tutorial.title: Review Unregistered Domains
tutorial.body: If other domains attempt to use the widget, they appear in the Unregistered Domains panel. Approve legitimate domains or dismiss the rest.

knowledge.title: Set up Knowledge Base
knowledge.description: Give the AI study material via Training Data, Active Sources, and Create with AI for accurate answers.
knowledge.autoDetectHint: Marked complete automatically once at least one active source or training-data entry exists.

tutorial.title: Open the Knowledge Base page
tutorial.body: From the sidebar, click Knowledge Base to start training your AI.

tutorial.title: Training Data tab
tutorial.body: Add core business info (FAQ, policies, hours, prices) as training entries. You can drag-and-drop to reorder.

tutorial.title: Active Sources tab
tutorial.body: Enter your website URL to be auto-crawled. Content stays in sync periodically so the AI is always up to date.

tutorial.title: Create with AI tab
tutorial.body: Pick a business type and category, then let the AI draft knowledge articles for you. Edit results as needed.

tutorial.title: AI auto-format
tutorial.body: On save, the system will auto-format content so it's easier for the AI to understand.

tutorial.title: Mark complete
tutorial.body: Once at least one source is active, click Mark complete. It also auto-completes when you add a source.

deploy.title: Deploy to your website
deploy.description: Install the widget snippet on your website, verify it appears, and send a test message.
deploy.deepLinkLabel: Open the Embed tab in Widget
deploy.autoDetectHint: Marked complete automatically once at least one chat session is received (meaning the widget is live).

tutorial.title: Copy the embed snippet
tutorial.body: Open the Widget page, pick the Embed tab, then click Copy to copy your widget script tag.

tutorial.title: Paste before </body>
tutorial.body: Open your website code and paste the snippet right before the closing </body> tag. For WordPress, use a footer code-injection plugin.

tutorial.title: Refresh the website
tutorial.body: Open your website in a browser and confirm the widget icon appears in the corner you configured.

tutorial.title: Send a test message
tutorial.body: Click the widget, send a test message, and confirm the AI agent answers correctly.

tutorial.title: Verify the domain
tutorial.body: Make sure your website domain is validated (see the Register Domain phase) so the widget isn't blocked.

tutorial.title: Mark complete
tutorial.body: Click Mark complete. Congrats — your chatbot is now live!
